prompt: A printer prints $5$ pages in $20$ seconds. At this rate, how many pages in $2$ minutes?
hint: The two times are in different units, one in seconds and one in minutes. Put them in the same unit before comparing.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Sketch a tape diagram: equal blocks for each part. What does one block represent here?
The two times are in different units, one in seconds and one in minutes. Put them in the same unit before comparing.
Two minutes is $120$ seconds, and $120 \div 20 = 6$, so the printer repeats its $20$-second job $6$ times. Multiply the $5$ pages by $6$.
$5 \times 6 = 30$, so the printer prints $30$ pages in $2$ minutes.

explanation: Change $2$ minutes into seconds so both times use the same unit: $2 \times 60 = 120$ seconds.
Count how many $20$-second blocks fit in that time: $120 \div 20 = 6$ blocks.
Each block produces $5$ pages, so multiply to get $5 \times 6 = 30$.
The printer prints $30$ pages in $2$ minutes.

alternativeExplanations.title: Scale up the ratio
steps: $5$ pages : $20$ sec. Multiply both sides by $6$ (since $20 \times 6 = 120$).
